verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores all notes as local plain Markdown files (open format) with no lock-in, explicitly marketed for easy future migration away from the app, and community testimonials confirm notes 'outlive the app' and support easy switching between tools. The only minor caveat is Canvas's JSON format, which is still local/open (MIT-licensed) though less human-readable than Markdown. Missing for 10: no explicit 'export' button/wizard is documented (export is implicit via direct file access) and no independent long-term migration case study beyond forum anecdotes.
